workspaceBoundary.interpretation: The working tree contains a separate authorized Save-flow repair. It is not the consumer baseline: workflow checks out literal d46 separately, and the wrapper verifies HEAD/tree and git diff --exit-code HEAD before runtime. This review does not claim all local working-tree flows equal d46.

findings: Existing selection requires exact available Shutdown iPhone 16 on pinned iOS 18.5 with x86_64 manifest, after immutable host/SDK/Mach-O/signature proof.
Malformed inventory, case-insensitive duplicate UUIDs or bounded enumeration timeout fails; it does not trigger fallback.
Only a valid inventory without an eligible exact device permits one 120-second creation. Existing selection is deterministic and records eligible count.
Preboot verification rechecks runtime/version/device uniqueness/type/state. Boot, bootstatus and install use the same exact UUID; app digest is checked before install.
Provenance records existing-shutdown versus fresh-creation and createdByThisInvocation, with no claim that a reused device is newly created.
Cleanup shuts down only the selected UUID and deletes only a device created by this invocation. Original iOS sign-in still clears application state and keychain.
Direct diagnostic retains 15-second reader readiness, both page/title assertions, Next memory, strict fixture and JUnit gates, 600-second CLI budget and 25-minute job cap.
All 85 original cases are unselected and receive no pass credit; warm diagnostic is not requested. No app rebuild, rebundle or re-sign is introduced.

verification.reason: Native reviewer already executed the frozen focused file independently; no third execution.

limits: Read-only source, exact byte and retained test-output review; no live macOS Simulator commands executed by this reviewer.
Exact existing-device availability is not guaranteed; metadata, boot or reader runtime can still fail.
This remains the original d46 app and does not include the later local reader recoverability repair.
